goal: Pipeline idempotency review: a data job that runs twice produces the same result, not duplicates.
use: Pipeline idempotency review: a data job that runs twice produces the same result, not duplicates. Use when a job is retried, re-run or scheduled.

steps.note: List the jobs. Each input, output and how it is triggered.
Check the writes. Flag inserts with no key, appends with no deduplication, and counters that add up twice.
Check the retries. Confirm a failed run can be repeated safely.
Check the partial runs. Flag jobs that leave half-written output.
Report. Each job with its risk of duplicates and the fix.
